items.title: Biogen (BIIB) Posts Positive Two Year Diranersen Results And Five Year Lecanemab Data
items.summary: Biogen (NasdaqGS:BIIB) reported positive two year Phase 2 CELIA results for diranersen in early Alzheimer’s disease. The firm released new five year data for lecanemab that showed sustained clinical benefit and reduced progression risk in treated patients. Management framed these late stage Alzheimer’s updates as key milestones for the company’s neurology pipeline. items.title: Biogen (BIIB) Stock May Be 49% Undervalued After Fresh Alzheimer’s Data
items.summary: Biogen has had a strong run over the past year, helped by fresh Alzheimer’s data and new product formats. With the stock now around US$250.79 at the last close, the key issue is how that market tag compares with what its cash flows can reasonably support. items.title: Biogen (BIIB) After Fresh Alzheimer’s Data, Is The Valuation Story Still Compelling?
items.summary: Biogen (BIIB) is back in the Alzheimer’s spotlight after new five year data for lecanemab and two year Phase 2 results for diranersen outlined sustained clinical benefits and supportive safety signals. Investors have been rewarding this stream of Alzheimer’s updates, with Biogen’s share price delivering a 41.04% year to date return and a 13.19% 90 day share price gain.
